provenance_note: Item records are prototype data. Names, prices and photographs come from House of Zera's own sourcing; the `sourcing.channel` on each item points at a real, researched EU reuse channel in sources.json to demonstrate how the routing and passport fields work end to end. It is not a record of a completed purchase from that supplier. Items whose channel is `local-thrift` are the ones sourced today.

items.name: Fringe sequin top
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the fringe sequin top: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of sequins macro, in jet black.
items.description: A hand-picked party top with an all-over sequin body and long fringe at the hem. Pulls on over the head with no fastenings, so it needs no fine motor control to wear.

sourcing.provenance: Hand-sourced in Austin, Texas and mended before listing.
sourcing.condition: Very good. Two sequins replaced by hand at the left shoulder.

passport.care: Hand wash cold, dry flat, do not iron sequins
passport.recyclability: Mono-material polyester body; sequins must be removed before fibre recycling

accessibility.notes: No zips, buttons or hooks. Sequin face is textured and may be uncomfortable against sensitive skin; the lining is smooth.

items.name: Cream crochet patchwork top
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the cream crochet patchwork top: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of crocheted blanket from the auction, in raw cream.
items.description: Squares of salvaged crochet joined into a loose, forgiving top. Open weave, no lining, and a wide neck opening.

sourcing.provenance: Reuse-grade cotton knitwear from a social-enterprise sorting stream, cut down and rejoined into patchwork.
sourcing.condition: Restyled from three donor garments. All joins reinforced.

passport.care: Hand wash cold, reshape and dry flat
passport.recyclability: Blended cotton-acrylic; mechanically recyclable, not suitable for chemical cotton recycling

accessibility.notes: Wide neck opening clears a head without stretching. Open crochet catches on rings and splints — a smooth base layer helps.

items.name: Gold panel jacket
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the gold panel jacket: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of gold texture, in antique gold.
items.description: A statement jacket rebuilt with vertical gold panels. Front closes with four large buttons that are easy to grip.

sourcing.provenance: Never-worn unsold stock diverted under the EU destruction ban, then re-panelled.
sourcing.condition: Deadstock, never worn. Original buttons swapped for larger, easier-to-grip ones.

passport.origin: Unsold EU retail stock, held in Romania
passport.recyclability: Mono-material polyester; buttons are removable for separate recycling

accessibility.notes: Buttons are 30 mm and set in loose buttonholes — chosen to be workable one-handed or with limited grip strength.

items.name: Tweed business shorts
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the tweed business shorts: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of tweed fabric clothing, in oat tweed.
items.description: Tailored wool tweed shorts with a flat front and a fixed waistband. Cut for a seated silhouette rather than a standing one.

sourcing.provenance: Hand-sourced in Austin, Texas; hem and waistband re-set.
sourcing.condition: Good. Waistband reinforced, hem re-set by hand.

passport.care: Dry clean, or hand wash cold with wool detergent
passport.recyclability: Mono-material wool; suitable for mechanical wool recycling once buttons are removed

accessibility.notes: Waistband is inelastic and sits high at the back, which suits wheelchair seating. The fly needs two hands.

items.name: Black fringe two-piece set
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the black fringe two-piece set: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of textile texture 7—black cotton, in jet black.
items.description: A two-piece set in tiered black fringe. Both pieces pull on, and the skirt has a wide elastic waist.

sourcing.provenance: A-grade rewearable eveningwear from a European sorting stream, restyled into a matched set.
sourcing.condition: Restyled from two donor pieces. Fringe re-anchored throughout.

passport.care: Hand wash cold, hang to dry, do not tumble
passport.recyclability: Mono-material polyester; fringe strands shed and should be captured in a wash bag

accessibility.notes: No fastenings on either piece. Wide elastic waist can be pulled on seated.

items.name: Sequin party tank
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the sequin party tank: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of silver sequins on lace, in gunmetal.
items.description: A simple sequin tank with wide straps and a straight hem. Straps are wide enough to cover a bra or a port site.

sourcing.provenance: Hand-sourced in Austin, Texas; straps widened.
sourcing.condition: Very good. Straps widened from spaghetti to 4 cm.

passport.recyclability: Mono-material polyester; sequins must be removed before fibre recycling

accessibility.notes: Pulls on over the head. Wide straps stay put without adjusting.

items.name: Wool overcoat
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the wool overcoat: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of wool texture 3, in charcoal wool.
items.description: A single-breasted wool overcoat, relined and rebuttoned. Cut long, with a back vent that opens when seated.

sourcing.provenance: Reuse-grade wool outerwear from a Dutch sorting stream, relined and rebuttoned.
sourcing.condition: Good. New lining, all buttons replaced with magnetic-backed alternatives.

passport.recyclability: Wool-polyester blend; shell is mechanically recyclable once lining is separated

accessibility.notes: Front buttons look conventional but close magnetically — they can be fastened one-handed. Back vent prevents bunching when seated. Not suitable near an implanted cardiac device.

items.name: Reworked wide-leg denim
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the reworked wide-leg denim: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of denim texture 14, in indigo denim.
items.description: Wide-leg denim pieced from two donor pairs, with a contrast panel down each outer leg and a side-zip opening.

sourcing.provenance: Reuse-grade denim from a Polish sorting stream, cut and rejoined into a wide-leg block.
sourcing.condition: Restyled from two donor pairs. Side seams reinforced with flat-felled construction.

passport.care: Machine wash cold, inside out, hang to dry
passport.recyclability: Near mono-material cotton; elastane content is low enough for mechanical recycling

accessibility.notes: Zip runs down the side seam rather than the front and ends in a 25 mm pull ring, so it can be worked with one hand or a dressing hook.

items.name: Organic cotton wrap dress
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the organic cotton wrap dress: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of cream linen, in undyed cotton.
items.description: A wrap dress in soft organic cotton that ties at the waist. The wrap opening means it can be put on without lifting the arms overhead.

sourcing.provenance: Cut from deadstock organic cotton jersey diverted from disposal under the EU destruction ban.

passport.care: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low
passport.recyclability: Mono-material organic cotton; suitable for chemical and mechanical recycling

accessibility.notes: Opens fully flat, so it can be dressed lying down or seated with assistance. The tie can be swapped for a hook fastening on request.

items.name: Kids graphic tee, deadstock cotton
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the kids graphic tee, deadstock cotton: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of linen texture, in bone jersey.
items.description: A soft cotton kids tee printed with a simple line drawing. Flat seams and a printed neck label instead of a sewn-in tag.

sourcing.provenance: Cut from designer deadstock jersey sold in small cuts, diverted from disposal.

passport.origin: Deadstock designer roll, held in the EU
passport.care: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low
passport.recyclability: Mono-material organic cotton; print area is water-based and does not block recycling

accessibility.notes: Flat-locked seams and a printed neck label — made this way for children with tactile sensitivity.

items.name: Performance leggings
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the performance leggings: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of african textile pattern, in slate.
items.description: Stretch leggings with a wide flat waistband and a geometric print. Full stretch in both directions, so they pull on easily.

sourcing.provenance: Rewearable activewear from a retailer take-back stream, re-waistbanded.
sourcing.condition: Good. New wide waistband fitted; original drawcord removed.

passport.care: Machine wash cold in a filter bag, hang to dry
passport.recyclability: Multi-fibre synthetic blend; currently downcyclable only. Wash in a microfibre bag.

accessibility.notes: No drawcord to tie. Four-way stretch and a wide flat waistband that does not dig in when seated for long periods.

items.name: Silk cami and short set
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the silk cami and short set: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of designm.ag fabric texture - 7, in champagne silk.
items.description: A silk cami and short set with mesh trim. Both pieces pull on, and the silk is smooth against skin throughout.

sourcing.provenance: Hand-sourced in Austin, Texas; mesh trim replaced.
sourcing.condition: Very good. Mesh trim replaced at both hems.

passport.care: Hand wash cold with silk detergent, dry flat away from sun
passport.recyclability: Mono-material silk; biodegradable, suitable for mechanical recycling

accessibility.notes: No fastenings and no interior seams against the skin. Often chosen by people with sensory sensitivity or chronic pain.

items.name: Mesh panel athletic jacket
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the mesh panel athletic jacket: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of mesh, in deep olive.
items.description: A light athletic jacket with mesh side panels for airflow and a full-length front zip with an oversized pull.

sourcing.provenance: Reuse-grade sportswear from a UK sorting stream, with mesh panels inset.
sourcing.condition: Good. Mesh panels inset at both sides; zip pull enlarged.

passport.origin: Post-consumer, collected in the United Kingdom
passport.care: Machine wash cold in a filter bag, hang to dry
passport.recyclability: Polyester-nylon blend; separable at panel seams for mono-material recycling

accessibility.notes: Zip has a 40 mm loop pull and a bottom stop that stays joined, so the zip can be started one-handed.

items.name: Silk button blouse
items.alt: Catalogue plate for the silk button blouse: the garment silhouette filled with a photograph of silk fabric, in ivory silk.
items.description: A silk blouse with a soft collar and a button front. Buttons are larger than standard and set in loose buttonholes.

sourcing.provenance: Hand-sourced in Austin, Texas; buttons and buttonholes reworked.
sourcing.condition: Very good. Buttons enlarged and buttonholes eased.

passport.care: Hand wash cold with silk detergent, iron on low from the reverse
passport.recyclability: Mono-material silk; biodegradable once buttons are removed

accessibility.notes: Buttons are 20 mm with eased buttonholes. Can be worn open over a pull-on layer if buttoning is not an option.

image_policy: Each piece is shown as its silhouette filled with a photograph of the actual textile. The fabric photographs are real, openly licensed images sourced through Openverse (Flickr, Rawpixel, Art Institute of Chicago) under CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0, and each item's `fabric` block carries the title, creator, licence and a link back to the source. Whole-garment photography without models does not exist at catalogue scale under an open licence, and repeating one stock photo across unrelated one-of-one pieces would misrepresent them, so the silhouette is drawn from the item's own `plate` and `colour` fields while the surface is real cloth. Set an item's `photo` to a file path to use a straight photograph instead.
